senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="C00632">same</cite>. . *<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 38:12">Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12</cite> <he>נחל גי׳</he> ed. Lag. (Rashi <he>גְּדוּדָאִין</he>) a wady between steep embankments (Var. <he>נְוַל גַּרְדָּאִין</he>, h. text <he>אֹרֵג</he>).—
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 41a:1">Sabb. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>לית ליה גי׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>גד׳</he>) has no steep banks.
Erub. 6ᵃ דאיכא גי׳ where there are yet embankments (remnants of ruined buildings).—בית ג׳ soil full of cuts, rough places.
Targ. Is. XL, 4 (h. text רכסים).—Trnsf. snares.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 31:21">Targ. Ps. XXXI, 21</cite> <he>גידודי גיבריא</he> (h. text <he>רכסי</he>) snares of mighty (violent) men (Ms. <he>גברי גדודי</he>).
